"use client"

import { useMemo } from "react"
import type * as z from "zod"
import { ZodProvider } from "@autoform/zod"
import { AutoForm } from "@/components/ui/autoform"
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

export function DynamicForm<TValue extends Record<string, unknown>>({ schema, initialValue, pending, error, success, onSubmit }: {
  schema: z.ZodObject<z.ZodRawShape>
  initialValue: TValue
  pending: boolean
  error: Error | null
  success?: boolean
  onSubmit: (value: TValue) => Promise<void>
}) {
  const schemaProvider = useMemo(() => new ZodProvider(schema), [schema])
  const formKey = JSON.stringify(initialValue)
  return <AutoForm key={formKey} schema={schemaProvider} defaultValues={initialValue} formProps={{ className: "space-y-6", noValidate: true }} onSubmit={async (value) => onSubmit(value as TValue)}>
    <div aria-live="polite" className="space-y-3">{error ? <Alert variant="destructive"><AlertDescription>{error.message}</AlertDescription></Alert> : null}{success ? <Alert><AlertDescription>Saved successfully.</AlertDescription></Alert> : null}</div>
    <div className="flex items-center justify-end border-t pt-5"><Button type="submit" disabled={pending}>{pending ? "Saving…" : "Save Changes"}</Button></div>
  </AutoForm>
}
